ns2:course.label: Advanced Ruminant Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Physiological and microbiological aspects of ruminant digestion and their influence on the metabolism of the extraruminal tissues; interpretation of nutritive requirements in terms of rumen microbial activities; and evaluation of research techniques. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: ANSC 420 or equivalent, and ANSC 350, MCB 450, or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ANSC 420 or equivalent, and ANSC 350, MCB 450, or equivalent.
